sentence: This project collects data over time from individuals with psychopathology to try to predict their clinical outcomes and find subgroups.
This project uses genome editing and stem cell models to find out how a variant of Reelin protects against Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how the parabrachial nucleus contributes to neuropathic pain, testing whether peripheral nerve injury makes excitatory dorsal horn interneurons more excitable.
This project uses organ-on-a-chip technology to find out how hesperidin, a natural compound, improves bone formation in a mechanically stimulated bone environment.
This project studies how neural cells of the cerebral cortex are generated and organized in the developing brain.
This project develops an oral inhibitor of the enzyme glutamate carboxypeptidase II to help recovery from peripheral nerve injury in aging.
This project studies how Chlamydia trachomatis causes inflammation but avoids being cleared by human immune defenses.
This project uses imaging to study the metabolism of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and to see if metabolic changes predict response to cytostatic drugs.
This project studies how protein complexes involved in transcription initiation are built in 3D and how activators and chromatin regulators change them.
This project tests whether myeloid cancer cells create metabolic dependencies in the heart that contribute to heart failure.
This project studies how foundation models for radiology imaging can be checked and refined to be explainable, transparent and able to handle rare pathologies.
This project builds a digital health resource for continuous cognitive assessment to help with early detection of Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how influenza virus infection changes over time in mallards and swine to learn how strains with pandemic potential arise.
This project studies how competition between cells shapes disease progression in patients with myeloproliferative neoplasm.
This project organizes an annual meeting where research on normal and abnormal visual perception is presented.
This project combines immunomagnetic capture, microfluidics and AI-driven analysis to identify pathogens and test antimicrobial susceptibility from whole blood.
This project studies the genetic and epigenetic events that drive tumor initiation and progression and looks for cancer therapeutic targets.
This project builds artificial intelligence models that use clinical notes and electronic health records to find early risk patterns for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
This project improves how occupational cohort data are analyzed to understand how low dose ionizing radiation exposure at work can cause cancer.
This project develops imaging technologies, imaging agents and image data processing algorithms for detecting and managing cancer.
